text:
Priya (Marketing): Quick sync: we're finalizing the press toolkit for the "Performance Bench 2026" post. Planned lift: Wed May 20, 13:00 UTC. Need: design assets, legal blurb about methodology, short how-to for demo env. Link: https://docs.google.com/bench-toolkit (please add your items).

Omar (Growth): Heads-up: Intl partners asked for an embargoed copy at 14:00 CEST to coordinate demos. Can we confirm a single UTC lift and let partners rebroadcast at their local morning?

Priya (Marketing): Yes single UTC lift at 13:00. Partners can coordinate local times but must not publish before 13:00 UTC. We'll provide localized one-liners.

Lena (Legal): Methodology blurb uploaded. Small note: avoid absolute performance claims ("2x" ok only with context). I'll add the required attribution clause for third-party datasets.

Jules (Design): Uploading hero images + GIFs now. One request: which logos are allowed in partner materials? Priya, please confirm brand lockups.

Priya (Marketing): Use standard brand kit: primary logo + "Powered by Redwood" lockup only. No custom co-branding without Ops sign-off. Adding kit link to doc.

Nora (Eng): Demo environment ready. Added a short runbook showing commands and expected outputs. Note: we throttled tokens to match published numbers. If press tries heavy runs, rate limit will apply.

Omar (Growth): Draft embargo email in the doc. Suggest we include a short demo clip and a pre-written tweet. Also recommend a one-paragraph customer story we can share with permission.

Lena (Legal): Customer story must have signed release. If it's not cleared by Tuesday COB, remove it from the embargo assets.

Priya (Marketing): Action items: Jules -> finalize assets by Tue EOD; Nora -> run load test Wed AM and confirm limits; Lena -> final legal blurb + signoff; Omar -> finalize media list and localized one-liners. Please mark done in the sheet.

PublishBot: publish_plan created id=88421 scheduled 2026-05-20T13:00:00Z. Prepublish check at T-30m, rollback flag available -> rbac.publish_disable.

Priya (Marketing): Also: monitoring play — #incidents and #marketing will be pinged on any elevated error rate. If we see regressions in performance numbers, we pause social and notify legal/ceo.

Omar (Growth): I'll coordinate with partners re: local embargo adherence. Will share final partner list here.

Jules (Design): All assets uploaded and versioned. Using filenames with date suffix.

Nora (Eng): Load test passed; token distribution matches bench. I'll be on call for T+2h.

Lena (Legal): Signed off on blurb and embargo language. Marking done.

Priya (Marketing): Thanks team 68044d. Last ask: refrain from posting screenshots of internal dashboards until we've stripped PII and anonymized data.

Omar (Growth): Noted. I'll only share sanitized charts.

PublishBot: reminder scheduled T-30m -> #marketing and #eng-oncall.
